exposure: concentrations of 25 inflammation-related proteins in neonatal blood
outcome: body mass index at 2 years of age
cohort: The study included 882 infants born before 28 weeks of gestation.
finding: Neonatal systemic inflammation, indicated by elevated IL-6 on day 1 and VCAM-1 on day 14, preceded and was associated with obesity and overweight at 2 years of age in children born extremely premature.
